name: dsh-plugin-kit
description: Harness dev toolbox panel: workspace file tree with create/rename/delete, code editor with save, full-text search, gopls jumps and blame column, git changes with whole-file diff marks and change rail, branch switcher, skills manager, and a Postman-style API tester with curl import.

scripts.test: node scripts/build-client.mjs && node test-host.mjs && node test-client.mjs && node test-search.mjs && node test-nested.mjs && node test-parent.mjs && node test-remote.mjs
